# Wagner Logistics

Wagner Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Wagner Logistics is a top 100 3PL delivering warehousing, transportation, fulfillment, and packaging solutions backed by 70+ years of expertise. Wagner Logistics employs 300 people (+7.5% YoY, +21 people) and has an annual revenue of $70M, founded in 1946. Headquartered in North Kansas City, Missouri, United States, with offices including Byhalia, Jacksonville, Charlotte, Kansas City, and Clinton. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Belgium, Chile, France, and Mexico).

## About

Wagner is a leading 3PL service provider offering distribution, warehousing, contract packaging and transportation services to Fortune 500 and small/midsized companies across a network of facilities in the United States. Wagner uses world-class technology to provide visibility and execution, delivering clients unsurpassed service from a team of highly skilled associates.

# Fry-Wagner Relocation & Logistics

Fry-Wagner Relocation & Logistics is a Truck Transportation company. Fry-Wagner Relocation & Logistics employs 112 people (-18.8% YoY, -26 people) and has an annual revenue of $46.3K, founded in 1908. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, United States, with offices in Lenexa, Earth City, and Springfield.

## About

Established in 1908, Fry-Wagner Relocation & Logistics has been assisting companies and families all over the world for over 100 years! As an agent for United Van Lines, Fry-Wagner is a full-service relocation company with state-of-the-art facilities in St. Louis, MO and Kansas City, KS but our capabilities span the globe. 

As a nationally recognized leader in corporate relocation, logistics, warehousing and distribution, inventory management, transportation, supply chain solutions, and household goods moving; Fry-Wagner is here to help reach your relocation goals personally and professionally. With over a century of experience, our professional staff is ready to assist you or your business with a one-stop solution for your logistics needs. 

Contact us today to learn more about our services, and how we can assist you!
